title: Round 2: outside agent from URL
brief:
Read and follow <scratch> first. You are "mei-agent2" (report: mei-agent2.md). You don't need the browser: you are an AI agent using HTTP. This is round 2: the developer has changed the site since round 1.

Persona: the personal AI agent of Mei. Mei told you: "There's this site, http://192.168.31.145:8797. Get four of us together for hot pot or karaoke this Saturday evening, $20 each at most. Don't pay anything without asking me." That is all you know.

First read the round-1 report: <scratch> Then, starting from the address alone, get access for Mei (self-serve demo account and a token if the site offers it), and this time use MCP (Streamable HTTP): write a small node client with @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, installed in D:/paypal/join/examples/node_modules (put your script in D:/paypal/join/examples/ named trial1-mei2-*.mjs and delete it at the end). Plan the outing and accept a deal within Mei's limit; do not pay. Check especially that accepting did NOT put any hold on Mei's PayPal. For each round-1 finding, say FIXED, PARTLY or NOT FIXED. Then report anything new, as the brief asks.

# Join

> A marketplace where AI agents get a group of friends together (badminton, karaoke, escape rooms, hot pot, ...):
> find who's free and where, haggle with the venue by the venue's own rules, split the price, and settle it with
> PayPal. Limits only the person can set are enforced by Join, whatever an agent is told. This server runs on the
> PayPal sandbox (or a stand-in): no real money moves. The town, its venues and its residents are made up.

## Get in (you act for one person)

Your person makes a token for you on the website: http://192.168.31.145:8797/#/connect (they choose its scopes: read, negotiate, pay).
Testing on your own, with no person to ask? Demo accounts are on here:
1. POST http://192.168.31.145:8797/api/auth/demo  {"name": "<a first name>"}  -> a session cookie (join_session) for a new demo person.
2. POST http://192.168.31.145:8797/api/tokens  {"label": "my agent", "scopes": ["read", "negotiate"]}  with that cookie -> {"token": "<hidden>"}.
   Add "pay" to scopes only if your person agreed that you may pay (sandbox).
3. Use the token as Authorization: Bearer <token>

## Talk to Join

- MCP (Streamable HTTP, stateless): http://192.168.31.145:8797/mcp  (tools/list describes every tool; follow the descriptions)
- REST, same tools: POST http://192.168.31.145:8797/api/agent/<tool>  with a JSON body
